archiveScope: Eleven installed standard archives. Nine carry 335 member pins selected by ten-custom exact link replays. OpenAL and HTML5 archive pins additionally cover retained upstream link requests. SDK zlib port reconstruction remains a separate scope.

hostFileSystem.evidence: Retained libc.a has _exit.o and _exit__1.o. Pinned SDK Library.build_objects lowercases basenames and resolves collisions only on a case-insensitive filesystem.
hostFileSystem.adapterScope: Select the pinned recipe case-insensitive object naming branch on Linux. Source and compiler flags are retained.

objectSectionScope: Diagnostic equality of exact serialized WebAssembly v1 section bytes, including section IDs, length encodings and custom names. Excludes only custom names beginning .debug_ or reloc..debug_. All other sections, including linking, reloc.CODE, reloc.DATA, producers and target_features, remain compared in order. This checks section framing, not instruction validity, semantic equivalence, archive order equivalence or whole bytes. Malformed/unsupported objects cannot produce section equality.

historicalClangHeaderPrefixEvidence.scope: Observed in211 member objects across the eleven exact pinned installed archives. This is debug-path reconstruction metadata, not a runtime prefix mapping.
